Third-party static dependencies for the Vita target

This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.

The following files are unmodified upstream license/notices for the exact
library versions identified in provenance.json:

libpng 1.6.58: libpng/LICENSE
libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0: libjpeg-turbo/LICENSE.md and libjpeg-turbo/README.ijg
zlib 1.3.2: zlib/LICENSE
Opus 1.6.1: opus/COPYING and opus/LICENSE_PLEASE_READ.txt
opusfile 0.12: opusfile/COPYING
libogg 1.3.6: libogg/COPYING
taiHEN 0.11 user import stub: taihen/LICENSE

Retain the complete license directory with redistributed archives and linked
application packages. These notices cover the listed libraries and do not
replace the separate license/notices for SceShaccCgExt or other modules.
